text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ نَزْغٌۭ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction joining the previous counsel to a conditional refuge protocol
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps this ayah joined to the previous ethical counsel while opening a new conditional procedure. The reader hears continuity rather than a hard break: the counsel about endurance now becomes a protocol for what to do when that endurance is threatened. Its short bound sound releases directly into the emphatic condition, so the boundary is audible as well as syntactic.

topics.headline: resumptive bridge into protocol
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refuge instruction continues the prior ethical counsel instead of beginning as an isolated maxim.
topics.reason: The conjunction precedes the whole conditional unit and coheres with the prior-to-current discourse boundary.

topics.headline: bound conjunction scopes over condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that coordination, resumption, and boundary attachment all point to the entire conditional remedy.
topics.reason: The local syntax makes the particle govern entry into the conditional rather than a single following word.

topics.headline: smooth audible entry into condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound surface easing the transition into the emphatic condition.
topics.reason: The phonetic row supports the same boundary effect without changing the syntax.

words.gloss_range: reinforced conditional particle opening an indefinite, repeatable case
words.prose: {{ar:إِمَّا}} ({{tr:immā}}) casts the satanic prod as an open, repeatable contingency rather than a single past incident. Its fused conditional shape launches a live procedure addressed to the hearer, and the doubled middle sound gives the possible intrusion audible insistence before the heavy verb arrives. The reinforced force makes any such intrusion fall immediately under the refuge rule that follows.

topics.headline: indefinite reinforced condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that any future satanic prod, not only one known episode, activates the same refuge protocol.
topics.reason: The conditional particle opens a non-specific case whose apodosis is the following command.

topics.headline: condition launches live procedure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from general counsel to direct conditional address.
topics.reason: The fused particle and following emphatic verb make the condition a live rule-trigger.

topics.headline: geminated opening pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audible insistence at the condition before the heavy verb arrives.
topics.reason: The sound observation is locally coherent and supports the reinforced conditional opening.

words.gloss_range: emphatic imperfect contact verb with second-person object suffix inside the conditional protasis
words.root_gloss_range: root field of pricking, goading, inciting, and stirring conflict; the local Form IV imperfect selects a vivid satanic prod reaching the addressee
words.prose: {{ar:يَنزَغَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:yanzaghannaka}}) makes the possible intrusion vivid and personal: the second-person suffix is reached before the event noun is named, and the heavy verbal form keeps the prod from feeling abstract. Satanic provenance is diagnosed without making Satan the subject, while the later event noun names what has struck the listener. The {{ar:ن ز غ}} ({{tr:n-z-gh}}) field narrows here to a pointed satanic goad that can begin inwardly before it becomes social rupture, recalling relational stirring after damage in 17:53 and 12:100 but catching it here before it spreads. The repeated root in verb and event noun, the rare distribution, and the tightened sound make refuge urgent rather than ordinary.

topics.headline: vivid contact with the addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threat reaches the addressed listener personally before it can be abstracted.
topics.reason: The verb is an imperfect with emphatic nun and a second-person object suffix inside the conditional protasis.

topics.headline: source diagnosed without enthroning Satan
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that satanic provenance is diagnosed while the event, not Satan, drives the grammar.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the source phrase prepositional and the later event noun the subject.

topics.headline: pointed goad before social rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small piercing impulse that can become conflict, while the local verb remains a satanic prod in this condition.
topics.reason: The broader root range supports prick, goad, and incitement pressure, but local grammar narrows it to the provocation event.

topics.headline: rare root moved inward before rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that scenes of Satan stirring relations are brought inward here before damage spreads (17:53; 12:100).
topics.reason: The explicit parallels show the same root in Satanic stirring contexts without overriding the local singular address.

topics.headline: verb and event noun lock together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action and its event name repeat the same root, making the disturbance lexically unavoidable.
topics.reason: The local verb and delayed gerund share the same root and refer to the same provocation.

topics.headline: recognizable refuge formula with tightened sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rarity, gemination, and the wider Satan-refuge circuit make the inward prod feel urgent rather than ordinary.
topics.reason: Distributional rarity, formulaic parallels, and sound rows intensify the locally selected contact sense.

words.gloss_range: source-marking preposition diagnosing the origin-domain of the provocation
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) diagnoses provenance. The particle marks the prod as coming from a hostile source-domain, and its position before the event noun lets the reader recognize origin before analyzing the impulse itself. Its nasal entry also softens into the source phrase before the sharper hostile name arrives.

topics.headline: source marker for hostile origin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the impulse is traced to a source-domain before being treated.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the definite source noun and marks origin rather than direct objecthood.

topics.headline: source phrase before event name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that source recognition precedes analysis of the impulse itself.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase appears before the delayed event noun and functions as one diagnostic unit.

topics.headline: nasal entry into source phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a soft sound transition into the hostile source phrase.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation supports the source phrase entry without changing grammar.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive source noun naming the known adversarial origin of the prod
words.root_gloss_range: root field of straying far, rebellion, and adversarial satanic agency; locally a definite source noun governed by the source preposition
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ}} ({{tr:al-shayṭāni}}) names the source as a recognized adversary while grammar keeps it inside a source phrase rather than making it the subject to confront. The {{ar:ش ط ن}} ({{tr:sh-ṭ-n}}) field adds moral distance and rebellion, with the enemy framing of 35:6 narrowed here to provenance for an inner prod. The ayah sets this hostile origin opposite the later turn into divine attachment, echoing the Satan-nazgh-refuge circuit of 7:200 and the refuge formula of 16:98. Even the assimilated definite article makes the known adversarial title arrive as one fused sound-shape.

topics.headline: recognized adversary under source marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Satan is named as known hostile source while remaining outside the subject slot.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, genitive under the source preposition, and not the delayed subject.

topics.headline: far-straying enemy valence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source is morally classified as rebellious enemy pressure, while local grammar still reads it as provenance.
topics.reason: The root and intertextual enemy framing support adversarial coloring but do not make the noun an actor-subject here.

topics.headline: hostile source opposed to divine attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah mapping movement from satanic source to divine refuge, a pattern also visible in the Satan-nazgh-refuge close (7:200; 16:98).
topics.reason: The local source phrase and later refuge phrase create the negative and positive poles of the ayah.

topics.headline: assimilated definite adversary title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that definiteness is recitationally fused into the adversarial name.
topics.reason: The assimilation rows are form-level support for the definite source title.

words.gloss_range: delayed indefinite gerund naming one actionable prod after the target and source have been felt
words.root_gloss_range: root field of pricking, goading, intrusive suggestion, and conflict-stirring; locally a singular indefinite event noun
words.prose: {{ar:نَزْغٌۭ}} ({{tr:nazghun}}) finally names the event after the addressee and source have already been staged, so the actionable unit is the intrusive event rather than fixation on the adversary. Its singular indefiniteness makes even one slight, unnamed prod actionable, and the clipped tanwin landing gives that small unit a complete stop before the response marker. The {{ar:ن ز غ}} ({{tr:n-z-gh}}) root repetition with the verb locks the protasis around one sharply diagnosed disturbance; the same root explains relational damage in 12:100 and appears in the refuge pattern of 7:200, but here the prod is caught at first contact.

topics.headline: one unnamed prod becomes actionable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even a single, unnamed instance of provocation is enough to trigger the command.
topics.reason: The gerund is an indefinite delayed subject, with the source phrase able to qualify the event.

topics.headline: event focus redirects response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the actionable unit is the intrusive event, not an invitation to obsess over the adversary.
topics.reason: The delayed subject position and sequencing stage contact and source before event classification.

topics.headline: slight but real inciting event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a small prick or goad can be spiritually serious, while the local noun remains the specific provocation event.
topics.reason: The root range supports prick, impulse, and incitement, but local form and syntax bind it to one event noun.

topics.headline: retrospective rupture becomes prevention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root appears where Satanic stirring is answered by refuge, with 41:36 catching the disturbance early (7:200; 12:100).
topics.reason: The supplied parallels are concrete and support prevention without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: same root names the performed prod
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun is not a loose label; it names exactly the act already expressed by the verb.
topics.reason: The verb and noun share the same root in the local protasis.

topics.headline: clipped indefinite landing before response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the small complete sound-unit landing before the response marker.
topics.reason: The tanwin sound row supports the form-specific payoff of singular indefiniteness.

words.gloss_range: apodosis marker turning the condition into an immediate commanded response
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from diagnosis to response. It marks the command as the formal answer to the condition and compresses the interval between recognizing the prod and seeking refuge. Its clipped sound accelerates the turn, so the response feels attached to the condition rather than delayed reflection.

topics.headline: formal answer to the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refuge is the required syntactic answer once provocation appears.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following command as the fa-marked apodosis.

topics.headline: compressed move into command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah leaves no reflective gap between diagnosis and refuge.
topics.reason: The bound response particle is attached to the imperative and functions as the hinge from protasis to apodosis.

topics.headline: short acoustic turn into command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clipped sound accelerating the response.
topics.reason: The sound row reinforces immediacy without adding a separate semantic branch.

words.gloss_range: Form X imperative commanding the affected addressee to seek protective refuge
words.root_gloss_range: root field of seeking shelter, clinging for protection, and being guarded; local Form X imperative selects requested refuge rather than self-produced resistance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَعِذْ}} ({{tr:istaʿidh}}) turns the one struck by the prod into the one commanded to seek refuge, with the command entering as a new practical beat immediately after the condition. The {{ar:ع و ذ}} ({{tr:ʿ-w-dh}}) field and Form X pattern make the response protective clinging and requested shelter, not self-mastered counterattack. The same threat-to-refuge circuit appears around recitation and Satanic disturbance in 16:98 and 7:200, while 41:14 supplies the surah's worship-pressure background.

topics.headline: the struck listener becomes seeker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same person touched by the prod is immediately assigned the refuge action.
topics.reason: The imperative is second-person singular in the apodosis and matches the prior object suffix.

topics.headline: protective clinging rather than counter-conflict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response is requested shelter with a protector, not wrestling the impulse on its own terms.
topics.reason: The Form X imperative and prepositional frame mark seeking protection through another.

topics.headline: response particle joined to imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command arriving as a new practical beat with no slack after the condition.
topics.reason: The bound response marker and hamzat-wasl joining support immediate imperative force.

topics.headline: Satanic threat answered by refuge formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the known Satan-threat-to-refuge circuit, especially where recitation or provocation is answered by seeking refuge with Allāh (16:98; 7:200; 41:14).
topics.reason: The cross-references and local prepositional frame support formulaic refuge while keeping the local trigger as this conditional prod.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition marking protective attachment and means with the divine name
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) supplies the protective attachment relation after the refuge command. It reverses the earlier source-vector: the movement is no longer from hostile origin, but by and with the divine refuge anchor. Its short bound onset joins smoothly into that anchor, so the sound surface matches the grammar of attachment.

topics.headline: protector relation after refuge command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refuge is grammatically attached to the protector, not located in a vague hiding place.
topics.reason: The preposition is prefixed to the divine name and marks the protector relation with the refuge imperative.

topics.headline: source vector reversed into attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices grammar itself turning movement from hostile source into protective attachment.
topics.reason: The prepositional contrast between source marking and protective attachment structures the ayah.

topics.headline: smooth onset into divine name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the short preposition joining smoothly into the refuge anchor.
topics.reason: The sound row supports the bound attachment relation.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the genitive refuge anchor and antecedent of the closing pronouns
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine-name field of deity, worship, devotion, and dependence; locally the determinate refuge anchor governed by the protective preposition
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) is the determinate refuge target, not a generic shelter term. The {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) field keeps refuge inside worshipful reliance, and the name becomes the pivot from hostile source to the closing assurance of hearing and knowledge. That pivot also answers the same-surah denial of divine knowing in 41:22 and recalls the bi-llah refuge formula of 16:98.

topics.headline: proper name governed by protective preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refuge destination is the proper divine name, not a generic shelter concept.
topics.reason: The divine name is genitive under the protective preposition and selected by the refuge command.

topics.headline: name carried into closing rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named refuge anchor remains present through the final hearing-knowing rationale.
topics.reason: The name supplies the antecedent for the pronoun chain and is immediately unfolded by the predicate pair.

topics.headline: refuge inside devotion and dependence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refuge is worshipful reliance, while the local sense remains the proper divine name under the refuge preposition.
topics.reason: The derivational and semantic pressure enriches orientation but does not replace the local proper-name function.

topics.headline: central turn from source to assurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine name as the structural turn from satanic provenance to secure attachment, answering same-surah denial and refuge formulas (41:22; 16:98).
topics.reason: The supplied parallels and local sequence place the name at the pivot into the explanatory close.

words.gloss_range: emphatic explanatory particle with attached pronoun returning the refuge rationale to Allāh
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) opens the reason for the command rather than a detached new statement. Its attached pronoun brings the refuge anchor forward as the emphatic subject of the final attributes, so the imperative rests on who the refuge-giver is.

topics.headline: explanatory inna after the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is grounded in attributes rather than left as an unexplained reflex.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence parses the final words as an explanatory clause after the imperative.

topics.headline: refuge anchor becomes clause subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Allāh moving from object of the preposition to emphatic subject of the rationale.
topics.reason: The attached pronoun is the subject of the emphatic particle and resumes the divine name.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun foregrounding identity and sharpening the following definite predicates
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) slows the close by restating the same referent independently after the attached pronoun. It also sharpens the predicate relation, so the hearing and knowing titles sound like the point of the rationale rather than incidental description.

topics.headline: independent pronoun after attached pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the close slowing down to foreground the refuge-giver before naming the attributes.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun follows the attached pronoun and delays the predicates.

topics.headline: pronoun sharpens definite predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hearing and knowing titles as the point of the assertion, not incidental description.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows the pronoun to reinforce the subject and separate it from the definite predicates.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive predicate naming stable divine hearing as the first half of the refuge rationale
words.root_gloss_range: root field of hearing, listening, attending, and heeding; locally a definite intensive divine predicate of responsive hearing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمِيعُ}} ({{tr:al-samīʿu}}) begins the attribute seal with responsive hearing. As a definite intensive predicate from {{ar:س م ع}} ({{tr:s-m-ʿ}}), it presents the refuge appeal as received and heeded first, then pairs that hearing with knowledge as a stable ground for the command. The balanced long-vowel pairing generalizes the rationale beyond one case, and 7:200 shows the same refuge close intensified here by pronoun focus and definiteness.

topics.headline: stable divine hearing title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearing as a stable divine title and predicate, not a one-time reaction to this plea.
topics.reason: The word is a definite intensive predicate after the pronoun frame.

topics.headline: hearing as responsive reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the refuge appeal as heard and heeded first, while local grammar keeps this as the first predicate in a paired attribute seal.
topics.reason: The hearing field supports responsive reception, and position before knowledge matches the voiced appeal before hidden reality.

topics.headline: hearing locked with knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a balanced hearing-knowing seal that generalizes the refuge command beyond this one case.
topics.reason: The paired definite predicates and long-vowel cadence bind hearing with knowledge as one rationale.

topics.headline: refuge close echoed and intensified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the refuge pattern recognized from 7:200, heightened here by the pronoun and definiteness.
topics.reason: The explicit 7:200 parallel supports an echo without changing the local predicate parse.

words.gloss_range: second definite intensive predicate closing the refuge rationale with comprehensive knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: root field of knowing, making known, and disclosed reality; locally a definite intensive divine predicate of comprehensive knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَلِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿalīmu}}) completes the paired predicate and lands as the final word, asserting knowledge alongside hearing rather than beneath it. From {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}), the close covers what the voiced plea alone cannot expose: the hidden source, degree, and danger of the prod are already fully known. The refuge close of 7:200 and the knowledge denial in 41:22 are answered here, while the final long-vowel cadence moves the ayah from open contingency to settled comprehensive knowledge.

topics.headline: second definite predicate completes pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices knowledge asserted alongside hearing as a stable divine title, not subordinated to it.
topics.reason: The word is a second definite intensive predicate coordinated with the hearing title.

topics.headline: knowledge covers hidden mechanics of the prod
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what remains unnamed or inward to the addressee is fully known to the refuge-giver.
topics.reason: The knowledge field covers disclosed and hidden reality, locally focused by the preceding satanic prod.

topics.headline: refuge close and knowledge denial answered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the 7:200 refuge close intensified here and the same-surah denial of divine knowledge answered (7:200; 41:22).
topics.reason: The concrete parallels support echo and polemical answer without replacing the local predicate function.

topics.headline: final certainty closes open contingency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from possible intrusion to settled comprehensive knowledge at the final word.
topics.reason: The final position, open conditional beginning, and cadence rows converge on closure under certain knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ن ز غ at words 2 and 5, followed by the refuge imperative at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The disturbance is an inserted verbal-social thrust: it tries to make the addressee relay discord through a retaliatory word. Seeking refuge interrupts transmission before an inward impulse becomes an outward reply.

activation_trace.role: The branch's corruption-between-parties image makes the impulse relational, aiming to turn the addressee against another person.
The branch's word-thrust image locates the attack in provocative language and the threatened counter-utterance.
Refuge as recourse and protected attachment supplies the interrupt that prevents the thrust from being passed on.
Literal audition places both the provocation and any spoken reply within divine hearing.
Knowledge as full disclosure covers the intention forming before it becomes speech.

changed_reading.after: When a provocative thrust tries to recruit you into rupturing a relation, do not retransmit it; seek God's protection before replying, because both the heard exchange and its hidden formation are known.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The source مِن الشيطان at word 4 is answered by فاستعذ بالله at words 6-7.
baseline_models.mechanism: The adversarial motion is away from alignment: distance, severance, and crooked opposition pull the addressee off course. Refuge reverses that vector through attachment and continued presence within divine protection.

activation_trace.role: Distance and severance supply the separating vector attributed to the satanic source.
Crooked opposition gives that distance a directional function: the impulse bends intention away from its prior course.
Adhesion and remaining within a shelter provide the counter-motion of protected attachment.
The worshipped God is the explicit attachment point, preventing refuge from remaining an abstract withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: Ask for protection when evil appears.
changed_reading.after: Treat the impulse as an off-axis pull toward separation, and reverse it by reattaching intention and dependence to God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative استعذ is explicitly governed by بالله and closed by السميع العليم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The refuge root can evoke both personal recourse and a protective object or formula. The named divine object plus hearing and knowing select direct relational address: the utterance works as appeal to an aware protector, not as autonomous verbal technology.

activation_trace.role: Personal recourse and attachment provide the governing relation between the threatened speaker and protector.
The warding-object or protective-formula branch supplies a live alternative that the construction redirects away from autonomous technique.
God as the worshipped one fixes the appeal on a personal divine addressee.
Hearing makes the refuge utterance an address that is received rather than a self-operating charm.
Knowing makes even the unspoken need available to the protector addressed.

changed_reading.before: Recite a protective phrase against temptation.
changed_reading.after: Make a direct appeal of dependence to the God who hears the appeal and already knows the threatened interior state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing attributes become a two-register accountability frame. Received sound can testify, while attempted concealment cannot remove inner uptake from divine knowledge; refuge therefore intervenes before heard provocation becomes concealed intention and then action.

activation_trace.role: Divine audition anchors the focus in the externally heard and uttered register.
Divine knowledge anchors the focus in the interior register before action.
Testimony as knowledgeable disclosure makes sensory reception evidentiary rather than transient.
The hearing faculty itself becomes a witness, sharpening the external side of the focus pair.
Literal covering supplies the failed concealment strategy against which divine knowledge is asserted.
The explicit denial of God's knowing turns the focus attribute into a corrective about hidden deeds and motives.

structural_cues: 41:20-22 makes hearing testify and contrasts attempted concealment with the false assumption that God does not know; 41:36 closes with the same hearing-knowing pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory testimony, failed concealment, and the repeated attributes; I infer a before-action accountability loop in 41:36. A live alternative is that the attributes only assure that the plea is heard and the threat known.

changed_reading.before: God hears the plea and knows the threat.
changed_reading.after: God registers both the provocation received through hearing and its concealed uptake into intention, so refuge is an accountable pause before response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Satanic incitement expands from a private impulse into a social communication system: attached companions beautify a frame, while opponents coordinate refusal to listen and mixed noise as a means of domination. Refuge protects meaningful uptake and prevents answering sabotage with more sabotage.

activation_trace.role: Interpersonal corruption anchors the coordinated campaign back in the focus disturbance.
The word-thrust branch makes speech and counter-speech the campaign's immediate medium.
An attached companion supplies the durable social carrier of the inciting frame.
Making something appear attractive explains how the carrier renders a corrupt frame persuasive.
Hearing as understanding and compliant uptake identifies the capacity the command not to listen tries to disable.
Mixed vocal noise supplies the literal interference used to prevent meaningful hearing.
Overpowering force names the intended social result of controlling the sound field.

structural_cues: 41:25 moves from attached companions to beautified framing; 41:26 immediately turns that framing into an explicit listen-block-noise-dominate sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, beautification, blocked uptake, noise, and domination; I infer these form a causal influence pipeline that instantiates nazgh socially. The alternative is that 41:25 and 41:26 describe separate modes of rejection.

changed_reading.before: A satanic whisper privately enters the individual.
changed_reading.after: Incitement can arrive through companions and an engineered noise environment that corrupts relations and hearing; refuge protects the listener from joining that communicative violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is an emergency brake inside a demanding de-escalation practice. Repelling harm with a better act can convert an enemy into a close ally, but that conversion requires self-restraint; nazgh is the retaliatory thrust that would abort the process, and refuge preserves it.

activation_trace.role: A word-thrust anchors the failure mode in the temptation to answer injury with injurious speech.
Protected recourse supplies the emergency interrupt when self-restraint is under pressure.
Removing and warding off harm supplies the active response that refuge is meant to keep from becoming retaliation.
A deliberately good act defines the superior mode by which the harmful input is redirected.
Explicit enmity supplies the hostile relation on which the better response operates.
Loving support and alliance name the transformed relation that a retaliatory nazgh would prevent.
Holding the self back from panic or complaint identifies the internal capacity needed to sustain the transformation.

structural_cues: 41:33-36 runs continuously from good speech, through better repulsion and enemy-to-ally transformation, to the patience gate and then the nazgh-refuge contingency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and its branch functions; I infer nazgh is the last-mile pressure toward retaliation that would derail the enemy-to-ally process. The live alternative is a standalone rule about any temptation, merely placed after the de-escalation instruction.

changed_reading.after: When the effort to answer harm with better conduct is about to collapse into a retaliatory word, use refuge as the fail-safe that preserves possible reconciliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Refuge is not only defensive shelter but a small act of directional worship. A crooked satanic pull is answered by reassigning bodily and inward dependence to God, anticipating the next ayah's correction of misdirected prostration.

activation_trace.role: Crooked opposition supplies the misdirecting vector that refuge must correct.
Recourse to a protector makes the correction an enacted dependence rather than a bare mental refusal.
The worshipped God is the exclusive endpoint of the corrected dependence.
Bodily lowering and submission literalize the directional choice between created signs and their creator.
The repeated divine object joins refuge to the immediately following exclusive prostration.
Submissive worship supplies the larger allegiance of which seeking refuge is a momentary enactment.

structural_cues: 41:36 directs refuge بالله; 41:37 immediately repeats لله while redirecting prostration from sun and moon to their creator.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated divine objects and a shift from refuge to prostration; I infer a shared act of reorientation from false dependence to exclusive worship. Alternatively, the two imperatives address unrelated threats: impulse and idolatry.

changed_reading.before: Refuge is a coping response to an intrusive impulse.
changed_reading.after: Refuge actively corrects the direction of dependence, turning an off-axis pull into renewed exclusive worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah develops separation as a trajectory: auditory heaviness makes a call feel remote, remoteness hardens into communal schism, and the close finally answers with God's complete enclosure in knowledge and protection. The focus refuge reverses that trajectory at its incipient satanic pull.

activation_trace.role: Distance and severance anchor the later spatial sequence directly in the satanic source.
Adhesion within a shelter supplies the focus's opposite motion toward protected nearness.
Literal heaviness in the ear makes separation first appear as blocked reception.
The reach and distance of a raised call spatialize failed communication.
Distance from nearness names the resulting communicative remoteness.
A group's splitting through disagreement turns auditory distance into social fracture.
Repeated distance intensifies the schism as a far-removed stance.
Guarding enclosure supplies the protective circumference toward which refuge moves.

summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet joined immediate de-escalation to earlier auditory sabotage and later distance-enclosure patterns, while branch images surfaced the contained word-wound and pre-emergence analogies that a local reading would likely miss.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the distance branch of ش ط ن is active enough here to sustain the full spatial trajectory rather than serve as an exploratory prompt.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A relational jab is prevented from becoming a relay.** Repeated **ن ز غ B001/B002** supplies inciting discord and a verbal jab; **ش ط ن B001/B003/B004** supplies remoteness, crooked opposition, and the rebellious instigator; **ع و ذ B001/B004** gives refuge and clinging close. I infer that incitement works by making the recipient retransmit hostility; refuge breaks that relay by changing proximity. The instruction directly protects 41:34's relational transformation.
2. **Hearing and knowing relocate the dispute.** **س م ع B001/B003** gives hearing and responsive understanding, while **ع ل م B001** gives clear knowledge. After a likely verbal provocation, the closing attributes establish a hearer and knower outside the antagonistic pair. I infer that appeal to that witness releases the addressee from proving the self through immediate counter-speech.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:40 closes another command to act with divine sight, repeating the relocation from reactive self-policing to comprehensive observation. 41:52's distant schism shows the endpoint when the remoteness branch of **ش ط ن** is allowed to govern.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Refuge interrupts sabotage before it becomes reciprocal conduct.** Lexically, `ن ز غ B001` is corrupting relations and inciting discord, `ع و ذ B001` turning for refuge and protection, and `ش ط ن B001` distance/remoteness. Structurally, the doubled `نزغ` follows 41:34’s conversion of enmity into intimacy and 41:35’s demand for restraint; the response is immediate `فاستعذ`. I assign incitement the role of reintroducing distance into a repaired relation and refuge the role of redirecting the impulse before action. The causal interruption is inferred from the sequence. The ayah reads as maintenance protocol for relational repair, not a disconnected formula against temptation.

2. **The counter-channel is heard and known.** `س م ع B003` includes receptive understanding and `ع ل م B001` knowledge as clarity. The closing attributes answer both the felt impulse and the spoken turn for refuge. I assign hearing the role of receiving the appeal and knowledge the role of encompassing the incitement’s source and trajectory. The inferred arrow is that refuge is effective because the appeal does not enter an opaque channel. This grounds the imperative in communicative access.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:37–38 supplied a positive counter-environment to incitement: signs redirect prostration and uninterrupted praise supplies a larger rhythm in which a discordant impulse can be refused. 41:39 added material responsiveness as another form of ordered orientation.

concept_map.definition: Birini niyet ettiği yönden ayırmak veya izlediği doğrultuya ters düşmektir. Yana yatıklık, kıvrımlı eğrilik ve çetinlik ise yalnız belirli varlıkları niteleyen bağımlı anlamlardır.

facets.statement: Yalın eylem, bir kişiyi niyet ettiği yön ve doğrultudan ayırmayı ya da ona ters düşmeyi anlatır.
Kalça için kullanıldığında bir yana yatıklığı, kuyu için kullanıldığında kıvrımlı ve eğri oluşu niteler.
Mızrak için kullanıldığında hem uzunluğu hem eğriliği birlikte anlatır.
Savaş için kullanıldığında savaşın kolay ilerlemeyen, ağır ve çetin oluşunu niteler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız genel bir çirkinlik adı vermez; belirli bir yılanın adı, çirkin bir bitkinin adı ve bitki başları için kurulan ürkütücü bir benzetme arasında ayrım yapar. Benzetmenin yılanı mı yoksa düşlenen azgın kötü varlığı mı çağırdığı konusunda da iki yorum bulunduğundan dal bu adlandırma ve yorum çeşitliliğiyle yeniden çerçevelenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal davranışsal başkaldırıyı değil, yılan ve bitkinin görünüşe dayalı adlandırılmasını ve ürkütücü baş benzetmesini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yılan için kullanılan tekil ad, bitkiye verilen ad ve baş benzetmesi ayrı tutulur; hiçbiri genel bir çirkinlik anlamına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Çirkin ya da ürkütücü görünüşlü belirli bir yılanın ve bir bitkinin kötü varlık adıyla anılmasıdır. Bitkinin başlarını böyle bir yılanın veya düşlenen azgın kötü varlığın başlarına benzetme de bu görünüşe dayalı adlandırmanın özel bir uzantısıdır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir yılan, çirkin ve ürkütücü görünüşü nedeniyle kötü varlık adıyla anılır.
Çirkin görünüşlü bir bitkiye de aynı varlığın başlarını belirten bir ad verilir.
Baş benzetmesi kimi yorumda hafif gövdeli ya da ibikli çirkin bir yılana, kimi yorumda ise düşlenen azgın kötü varlığa dayanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım bir yılanın çirkin görünüşü nedeniyle kötü varlık adıyla anıldığını ve çirkin bir bitkinin başlarının da aynı adla belirtildiğini aktarır. Baş benzetmesinin dayanağı konusunda hafif gövdeli ya da ibikli çirkin yılan ile düşlenen azgın kötü varlık arasında iki yorum bulunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalı, doğum yapmış dişinin ilk günlerdeki özel durumu olarak verir; başka dallardaki sığınma veya genel bağlılık anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Doğum yaptıktan sonraki ilk günlerinde bulunan dişidir; bu dönem kaynaklarda genellikle yedi günle sınırlandırılır. Aynı adın çoğul biçimi, bu durumdaki dişiler topluluğunu gösterir.

facets.statement: Bir dişinin doğumdan hemen sonraki ilk günlerde içinde bulunduğu özel durumu adlandırır.
Bu doğum sonrası dönem çoğunlukla yedi güne kadar sürer ve çoğul biçim aynı durumdaki dişileri topluca gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yeni doğum yapmış dişiyi doğumdan sonraki sınırlı ilk dönem içinde adlandırma konusunda birleşir. Süre çoğunlukla yedi gün olarak verilir ve topluluk için ayrı bir çoğul biçim belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tür ayrımı yapmadan, yeni doğum yapmış dişinin yaklaşık ilk yedi günlük durumunu karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Dişi olma, yeni doğum yapma ve süreli ilk dönem öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğumun hemen ardından gelen ilk günlerdeki dişiyi doğal akışta belirtmek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dişinin yakın zamanda doğum yapmış olması koşulunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Yaklaşık yedi günlük üst sınırı açıkça belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği doğum yapmış dişinin sınırlı süreli niteliğidir; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise doğum olayı ve onun kadın ile çocuk üzerindeki sonuçlarıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda doğumun gerçekleşmiş olması ve ilk günlerle sınırlı bir dönem zorunludur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yavrusu yanında olan ya da karnında yavru taşıyan dişiyi kapsar ve doğum sonrası kısa süreyle sınırlı değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dişi ile yavrusu arasındaki doğum çevresindeki bağı işler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada belirleyici koşul yeni gerçekleşmiş doğum ve ardından gelen kısa dönemdir; komşu dalda belirleyici koşul yavrunun dişiyle birlikte veya karnında bulunmasıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه وصف الأنثى، وخاصة الناقة أو الظبية أو الفرس، إذا وضعت ولدها في أيامها الأولى وجمعها عوذ، مع تعليل الملازمة بينها وبين ولدها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق الأنثى، ولا مطلق الملازمة بلا ولادة، ولا مطلق طلب الحماية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: لكل أنثى إذا وضعت عائذ وتكون كذا سبعة أيام والجمع عوذ (maqayis)؛ كل أنثى عائذ إذا وضعت مدة سبعة أيام والجميع عوذ (ayn)؛ العوذ الحديثات النتاج من الظباء والإبل والخيل واحدتها عائذ (sihah)؛ الناقة إذا وضعت ولدها فهي عائذ أياما وجمعها عوذ (tahdhib)؛ كل أنثى وضعت فهي عائذ إلى سبعة أيام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi önce her türlü yapışma veya bir şeye bağlı kalma çekirdeğini verir, ardından diken dibindeki ot, kemiğe bağlı et ve taş ya da kütük çevresinde dönen şey örnekleriyle bunu somutlaştırır. Verilen çerçeve bu çekirdek ile örnekleri doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Fiziksel olarak yapışma, dibinde kalma veya çevresinden ayrılmama bu dala girer; yalnızca korunmak için sığınma ya da soyut bağlılık tek başına girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel yapışma ve bağlı kalma çekirdeğini öne alır; bitki, et ve çevrede dönen şey anlamlarını bu çekirdeğin ayrı, yapıya bağlı somutlaşmaları olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeye fiziksel olarak yapışması, onun dibinde kalması veya çevresinden ayrılmamasıdır. Diken dibindeki erişilmesi güç ot, kemiğe bağlı et ve rüzgârla taş ya da kütük çevresinde dönen şey bu çekirdeğin ayrı somutlaşmalarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin başka bir şeye fiziksel olarak yapışması veya ondan ayrılmadan yanında kalmasıdır.
Dikenin dibinde ya da hayvanın güçlükle ulaşacağı sert bir yerde yetişen ot, dibinde kalma örneğidir.
Kemiğe sıkıca bağlı kalan et, yapışma çekirdeğinin bedensel örneğidir.
Rüzgârın taş ya da kütük çevresinde döndürdüğü ve o çevreden ayrılmayan şey, çevrede kalma örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, bir şeyin başka bir şeye yapışması ya da onun yanında kalmasıdır. Toplu tanıklık bu çekirdeği diken dibindeki ot, kemiğe bağlı et ve rüzgârla bir taş veya kütüğün çevresinde dönen şey gibi farklı somut örneklerle açar.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeye yapışıp onun yanında kalan şey
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın fiziksel yapışma ve ayrılmadan yanında kalma çekirdeğini, özel örnekleri tek tek genelleştirmeden karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel yapışmayı, bağlı kalmayı ve iki şey arasındaki ilişkiyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bitkinin diken dibinde veya hayvanın kolay ulaşamayacağı sert yerde yetiştiği özel kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkiyi, dibinde yetiştiği korunaklı yeri ve erişilme güçlüğünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Etin kemikten ayrılmadan ona bağlı kaldığı bedensel kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Etin kemiğe sıkıca bağlı kalması ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: taşın ya da kütüğün çevresinde dönen şey
contextual_glosses.applicability: Rüzgârın bir şeyi taş veya kütük çevresinde döndürdüğü özel kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Rüzgârla dönmeyi, merkezdeki nesneyi ve onun çevresinde kalmayı korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, terimi bir tanıklıkta atın tasma geçen boyun yeri, başka bir tanıklıkta ise bu yerde bulunan dairesel beden işareti olarak verir. Bu yüzden dal çerçevesi yer anlamı ile o yerdeki işaret anlamını birbirine indirgemeden birlikte korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Atın tasma yeri ile bu yerdeki dairesel beden işareti bu dala girer; tasmanın kendisi, genel boyun bölgesi veya koruyucu nesne anlatılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, atın tasma yeri ile bu yerdeki dairesel işaret kullanımını aynı dalın iki kaynak gerçekleşmesi olarak ayırır; beğenilme bilgisi yalnızca dairesel işarete bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Atın boynunda tasmanın geçtiği yer veya bu yerde bulunan dairesel beden işaretidir. Beğenilme niteliği, özellikle bu dairesel işaret için belirtilir.

facets.statement: Terim, atın tasma geçen boyun yerini veya bu yerde bulunan dairesel beden işaretini adlandırır.
Bu dairesel işaret, atlarda beğenilen bir özellik olarak değerlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar, terimi ya atın tasma geçen boyun yeri ya da bu yerde bulunan dairesel beden işareti için kullanır. Beğenilme bilgisi, dairesel işaret kullanımına bağlıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Atı, boyundaki kesin konumu ve işaretin dairesel niteliğini korur.

error_profile.preserves: At üzerindeki daireyi, boyun bölgesini ve beğenilme niteliğini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki sonuçsuz saldırı yolunu aynı kalıp içinde birleştirir: rakip yalnız korkutur ve vurmaz ya da öldürmek amacıyla vurur fakat öldüremez. Verilen çerçeve, kişinin bu tamamlanmamış eylemden kurtulması sonucunu doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel kaçış değil, rakibin korkutma veya öldürmeye yönelen fakat tamamlanmayan eyleminden sağ kurtulma anlatılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca verilen kalıp yapıya bağlıdır; korkutma ya da öldürme girişiminin tamamlanmamasıyla gerçekleşen kurtuluş, yalın bir kök anlamı gibi genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir kalıp içinde, kişinin rakibinden ya yalnızca korkutulup hiç vurulmadan ya da öldürülmek üzere vurulduğu hâlde ölmeden kurtulmasıdır. İki durumda da rakibin amaçladığı zarar tamamlanmaz.

facets.statement: Kişinin rakibin tamamlanmamış korkutma veya öldürme eyleminden kurtulmasıdır.
Birinci gerçekleşmede rakip kişiyi korkutur fakat ona vurmaz.
İkinci gerçekleşmede rakip öldürmek amacıyla vurur fakat kişiyi öldüremez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Rakibin yalnızca korkuttuğu ve fiziksel saldırıya geçmediği birinci seçenek için kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda kurtuluş, rakibin saldırıyı tamamlayamaması veya korkutmayla yetinmesi sonucudur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir tarafın diğerini korkutması ortak olay bileşenidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, savaş sırasında topluluğun üyelerinin işi birbirine bırakmasını ve her birinin ötekine sığınmasını tek bir karşılıklı davranış olarak verir. Verilen çerçeve hem savaş koşulunu hem de sorumluluğun karşılıklı aktarılmasını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel yardımlaşma veya tek yönlü sığınma değil, savaşta işi birbirine bırakıp karşılıklı olarak birbirine dayanma anlatılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalnızca savaşta topluluğun karşılıklı işi birbirine bırakması ve birbirine sığınmasıyla sınırlı özel kullanımı korur; bunu genel bir dayanışma anlamına yaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Savaş sırasında bir topluluğun üyelerinin sorumluluğu birbirine bırakması ve her birinin ötekine sığınarak işi üstlenmekten geri durmasıdır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kuyunun kendisini suyunun bol olması koşuluyla adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temel adı doğan veya atmaca türünden yırtıcı kuş için verir ve geçici dal görüntüsünü doğrular. Çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi ise kuş adından türetilmiş ayrı bir biçimdir; kuşun tanımına doğrudan katılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yırtıcı kuş adıdır; çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi yalnızca bu addan türeyen biçime bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal doğan veya atmaca türünden kuş adını tanımlar; insan nitelemesi türemiş bir sözcüksel uzantı olarak bağımlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Doğan veya atmaca türünden bir yırtıcı kuş adıdır. Bu kuş adından türetilen bir niteleme, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği anlatır.

facets.statement: Ad, doğan veya atmaca türünden avcı bir kuşu gösterir.
Kuş adından türeyen insan nitelemesi, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal tek bir sözlük tanıklığında yırtıcı kuş adı ile bu addan türetilmiş çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesini birlikte sunar.

error_profile.preserves: Yırtıcı kuş sınıfını ve doğan ile atmaca karşılıklarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuş adından türemiş insan nitelemesinin kullanıldığı bağlama özgüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Aynı kuş alanını paylaşsalar da komşu dal renk ve ara tür özellikleriyle daha dar bir kuşu adlandırır; odak dalın türemiş insan nitelemesi de komşuda yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğan veya atmaca türünü genel bir adla karşılar ve bu addan insan nitelemesi türetir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle zeki ve keskin bakışlı doğanlara verilen bir adı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: doğan adı ile zeki doğan nitelemesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal doğan türünden yırtıcı kuşları adlandırır ve zekâ çağrışımını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda zekâ kuştan türetilen insan niteliğinde belirginleşir; komşuda ise doğrudan belirli doğanların özelliğidir.

A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
